baselinePerformanceProbe.outcome: Strict baseline export rejected a legacy political peerage; no usable timing result. All final 100/300/500 phase fixtures use regional-1 native checkpoints on both versions; the eight natural seeds were not changed.

limitations: Eight independent seeds; repeated 100/200/300/500 prefixes are checkpoints, not independent worlds.

Family closure and permanent ambition are rule changes: world hashes, RNG positions and natural histories are allowed to differ; no full-world equality claim. Common permanent-source command/strategy values remain unchanged.
Natural run wall times share development CPU load and are not used for performance claims. Phase/UI/save comparisons are measured serially after development workloads finish.
Before/after native worlds can have different histories and populations. Timing comparisons include changed workload size and do not isolate a pure algorithm speedup.
Electron offscreen Core and React checks are not human visual acceptance; render CPU is not GPU or a GC diagnosis.
Rare political or career samples not present in natural runs remain controlled-Core evidence, not claimed natural frequency.
